name: Nischay Verma

experience.description:
Integrated Amazon Q Business into Expedia’s GenAI Studio by extending AI agent workflows, OpenAPI tooling, and function execution pipelines for seamless in-platform access.
Architected a context-aware AI agent leveraging Amazon Q Business and RAG capabilities to support client usage analysis, while authoring technical documentation for system design and workflows.
Revamped observability by optimizing 5 Datadog monitors, introducing 3 new monitors, and replacing static thresholds with relative metrics for improved alert reliability.
Automated PCS configuration validation through a Python diff-check utility that detected environment-specific discrepancies in endpoints and filters across deployments.

Surveyed literature on emotion understanding, domain adaptation, and incremental learning to design a progressive emotion classification framework.
Implemented a multimodal pipeline combining 3D-CNN, LSTM, and Random Forest models for emotion recognition on the MELD dataset containing 12,599 labeled conversations.
Mitigated severe class imbalance using weighted loss functions and SMOTE, improving minority-class recognition across seven emotion categories.
Achieved 68.36% accuracy with a 268M-parameter model, performing within 0.34 percentage points of the state-of-the-art benchmark on MELD.

projects.name: Product Price Predictor (Amazon ML Challenge)
projects.description:
Constructed a dense feature-stacking regression pipeline using DistilUSE multilingual embeddings and a supervised MLP (1024→128 latent stack), extracting and concatenating latent representations (256+128+128) to improve feature expressiveness for price prediction.
Leveraged XGBoost on stacked latent embeddings with feature scaling and ensemble tuning, achieving a SMAPE of 59.87% and outperforming raw-embedding baselines in predictive stability and accuracy.

projects.name: Reel To Trip (TBO VoyageHack)
projects.description:
Engineered a scalable multi-agent AI backend using TypeScript, Node.js, Express, and LLMs to transform social media content into structured travel itineraries.
Orchestrated RESTful APIs integrating geospatial services, web scraping, and pricing engines, delivering sub-minute itinerary generation and reducing manual trip-planning effort.

projects.name: NITJ Navigator
projects.description:
Implemented an A* search-based navigation engine for NIT Jalandhar, computing shortest paths across 17 campus locations with average query latency below 3 seconds.
Modeled the campus as a weighted graph and optimized pathfinding heuristics to improve route computation efficiency and accuracy.
